Title: uTPro Mail Hub
Description: Self-contained email monitoring, audit history, and delivery metrics dashboard for Umbraco 17 and 18. Transparently wraps Umbraco's built-in IEmailSender decorator so every transactional and system email (member invites, password resets, shop notifications, custom contact forms) is automatically tracked with zero host code changes. Logs sender, recipients (To/Cc/Bcc), subject, body, email type, source, timestamps, status (Sent/Error), and detailed error stacktraces. Includes a rich backoffice dashboard in Settings with volume metrics, success/error distribution, source/type breakdown, recipient domain stats, filterable history, and email resend/delete actions. Cross-database (SQL Server, SQLite, PostgreSQL) via NPoco migrations with automatic retention cleanup.
